text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Just a little longer until the 'Arima 
Kinen'...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I changed my running route on a whim just 
for a change of pace, but――)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Here...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*――No good. At this 
rate... she's just gonna pull further and 
further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I know it. I don't have anywhere near 
enough stamina... To begin with, our 
physical builds are just completely 
different.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (This is Kris S-san's running route.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(So nostalgic... This is where I chased 
after her back. It was only two years ago, 
but it feels like so long ago.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...It's been a while, maybe I'll just... 
run all the way like this."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Is this the goal line?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I don't get out of breath from just this 
anymore. Back then, I never thought about 
the trip back and used up all my energy――)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, in the end... Kris S-san had 
to support me on the way home, didn't 
she?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(She wasn't out of breath at all. Feeling 
her steady, regular breathing against 
me... come to think of it, I was jealous—)
...Heh, heh, heh.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Ah, that's right. Just like this...)
—Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh... K-Kris S-san!? T-T-The real deal!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: An impostor of me... I've never seen one.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I'm so sorry! Um, I didn't mean to 
say something so strange...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... so, Kris S-san, are you out for a 
run today... too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I chased after you to get here.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――I chased after you. ――I came... so we 
could talk.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy. —Will you achieve the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Is that... what you ought to be doing 
right now?”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Besides, it's what must 
be done—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It is also something that must be done.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Even if it means wagering everything 
that I am, I will achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...That's it. That was... it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —A radiance—that's what it is.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Before the debut.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――You said you would follow me―― ――and you 
really kept up to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —At the 'Japanese Derby'.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――You sprinted on―― ――to earn the right to 
be a hero.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Last year, on the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――You said you would never forgive me―― 
――and hurled all that fury against me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—It was radiance. Everything. 
—Now—finally, I... understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's all... yours. —The brilliance... of 
your will.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Everything was shining. Dazzling, 
...powerful, and,

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —A light that I... do not have.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……That's why I wavered.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……, ――I was captivated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: To that light. —I was drawn... to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I want to run with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Just—once more.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if it's because... I've been 
immersed in books ever since I was 
little.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(When it comes to putting things into 
words, I tend to... well, I tend to pile 
on far too many words.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(That's why... for the first time in my 
life, my chest hurt so, so much.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I want to see that radiance... —Up close.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy. I...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(My heart ached. At the few, precious 
words quietly trickling from her—from Kris 
S-san's thin lips.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Because it pierces through me... so 
strongly, so deeply.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...Is that so. ...In that case."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is no time for the two of us to be 
just standing around here, is it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's only a little time left before the 
Arima Kinen. ...I need to make the most of 
every second and train.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san. I—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I won't lose. ...Not a chance!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――... Yeah.
